scripts.build: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:/opt/homebrew/lib/ruby/gems/4.0.0/bin:$PATH" && cd www && pnpm build:example && cd ../example && flutter build macos --release && cd build/macos/Build/Products/Release && ditto -c -k --keepParent "Solid Flutter Demo.app" ~/Desktop/SolidFlutterDemo.zip && echo "Zipped to Desktop"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names vite,flutter --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter ./www dev" "cd example && flutter run -d macos"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently --kill-others --names vite,flutter --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter ./www dev" "cd example && flutter run -d ios"
